summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ReviewFlow hybrid review management platform. All backend APIs (24/24 tests passed) and frontend features working correctly. The app successfully runs in Demo Mode with MOCKED Google and Facebook APIs. Sync Reviews functionality works, generating varied reviews with different ratings and sentiments.
passed_tests: Landing page loads correctly with hero section, CTA buttons, and stats
API /api/health returns healthy status
API /api/ returns API info with version
API /api/auth/me properly rejects unauthenticated requests (401)
API /api/auth/me returns user data with valid token
API /api/integration-status requires authentication
API /api/integration-status returns Google and Facebook integration status
API /api/business returns business data for authenticated user
API /api/google/search requires authentication
API /api/google/search returns mock business results
API /api/google/connect creates reviews and returns integration mode
API /api/facebook/search requires authentication
API /api/facebook/search returns mock page results
API /api/facebook/connect creates reviews and returns integration mode
API /api/reviews requires authentication
API /api/reviews returns reviews list with proper structure
API /api/reviews supports platform and sentiment filters
API /api/reviews/private returns only private feedback (is_private=true)
API /api/reviews/sync requires authentication
API /api/reviews/sync syncs reviews from connected platforms
API /api/platforms returns platform connection status
API /api/analytics/overview returns analytics with sentiment breakdown
Reviews have varied ratings (1-5 stars)
Reviews have varied sentiments (positive, neutral, negative)
Dashboard shows Demo Mode badge when no real API keys configured
Dashboard has Sync Reviews button when platforms are connected
Dashboard shows stat cards (Total Reviews, Avg Rating, Response Rate, Platforms)
Dashboard shows Private Feedback alert with count
Dashboard shows Sentiment Score orb with positive/negative counts
Integrations page shows Google Business and Facebook Page as Connected
Reviews page shows Public Reviews and Private Feedback tabs with counts
Reviews page has platform and sentiment filter dropdowns
seed_data_creation: Created test user and session via MongoDB for authenticated testing

mocked_apis.note: Google Places API and Facebook Graph API are MOCKED by default
mocked_apis.google: Uses mock data - add GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY to backend/.env for real reviews
mocked_apis.facebook: Uses mock data - add FACEBOOK_APP_ID and FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET to backend/.env for real reviews

context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested and working. The app runs in Demo Mode with mocked Google and Facebook APIs. Test user created with session token 'test_session_1768051374411'. Both platforms (Google and Facebook) are connected for the test business. 48 reviews generated with varied ratings and sentiments. Private feedback (ratings < 4) properly marked as is_private=true.
